Klasse Continuation<A,R>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Continuation<A,R>
Typparameter:
A - the produced value type (the input of the final continuation function)
R - the overall result type of the CPS computation
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Function<Function<A,R>, R>, H2Appliable<Continuation.µ, A, R>, H2Bindable<Continuation.µ, A, R>, H2Mappable<Continuation.µ, A, R>, H2Monadic<Continuation.µ, A, R>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Continuation.µ, A, R>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Continuation.µ>
public class Continuation<A,R> extends Object implements H2Monadic<Continuation.µ, A, R>, Function<Function<A,R>, R>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Continuation.µ, A, R>

Models a continuation in continuation‑passing style (CPS). A continuation stores a function of the shape runCont: (A -> R) -> R, i.e., it expects a consumer for the produced value A and returns a result of type R.

This corresponds to Haskell’s Cont r a, where the parameter order here is <A, R> (value, result). In other words: Continuation<A, R> ≙ Cont r a with r = R and a = A.

The type supports the usual functor/applicative/monad operations: map, applyTo (applicative application), flatMap (flatMap), and apply to run the continuation with a final computation.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null. Null‑checks are enforced to keep Java usage safe while preserving CPS semantics.

Examples: 

  // 1) Plain CPS pipeline: map and flatMap
  // runCont: (A -> R) -> R, with A = Integer, R = Integer
  var cont = Continuation.<Integer, Integer>pureContinuation(5)
      .map(i -> i * 2)            // 10
      .flatMap(i -> Continuation.pureContinuation(i + 1)); // 11

  // Apply the final continuation (A -> R). Here we choose identity to get the produced value:
  var result = cont.apply(x -> x); // 11

  // 2) Early exit with call/cc (call-with-current-continuation)
  // If a condition holds, invoke k(...) to short-circuit and return immediately.
  var earlyExit = Continuation.<Integer, Integer>pureContinuation(5)
      .flatMap(i -> Continuation.callCurrentCont(
          (java.util.function.Function<Integer, Continuation<Integer, Integer>>) k -> {
              if (i > 0) {
                  // abort the rest of the computation and return 42 now
                  return k.apply(42);
              } else {
                  // proceed normally
                  return Continuation.pureContinuation(i);
              }
          }
      ));

  var exited = earlyExit.apply(x -> x); // 42

    • continuation

      public static <R,A> Continuation<A,R> continuation(@NonNull Function<Function<A,R>, R> runCont)

      Constructs a Continuation from a CPS runner function runCont. The runner consumes a continuation (A -> R) and produces R.

      Typparameter:
      R - the result type
      A - the produced value type
      Parameter:
      runCont - the CPS runner, of type (A -> R) -> R; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a new Continuation
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if runCont is null or returns null
      Seit:

    • pureContinuation

      public static <R,A> Continuation<A,R> pureContinuation(@NonNull A value)

      Typparameter:
      R - the result type (arbitrary for the literal continuation)
      A - the produced value type
      Parameter:
      value - the value to applyTo; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a continuation that immediately applies value to the provided continuation

    • map

      public <B> @NonNull Continuation<B,R> map(@NonNull Function<? super A, ? extends B> transformation)

      Functor map: transforms the produced value while preserving the CPS structure. Defined as map g = k -> runCont (a -> k (g a)).

      Angegeben von:
      map in Schnittstelle H2Mappable<Continuation.µ, A, R>
      Typparameter:
      B - the target value type
      Parameter:
      transformation - mapping A -> B; must not be null and must not return null
      Gibt zurück:
      a continuation producing B within the same R
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if transformation is null or returns null

    • applyTo

      public <B> @NonNull Continuation<B,R> applyTo(@NonNull org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<? extends Continuation.µ, Function<A,B>, R> transformation)

      Applicative application (applyTo): applies a continuation holding a function to this continuation’s value. Conceptually, ap cf cx = k -> cf.run (t -> cx.map(t).run(k)).

      Angegeben von:
      applyTo in Schnittstelle H2Appliable<Continuation.µ, A, R>
      Typparameter:
      B - the target value type
      Parameter:
      transformation - a continuation producing a function A -> B; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a continuation producing B
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if transformation is null or its function yields null

    • callCurrentCont

      public static <R,A,B> Continuation<B,R> callCurrentCont(@NonNull Function<Function<A, Continuation<B,R>>, Continuation<A,R>> computation)

      call/cc (call-with-current-continuation) for Continuation: provides an escape continuation k to the computation, allowing early exit or non-local control flow.

      Usage sketch: callCurrentCont(k -> /* build a computation that may invoke k(a) to short-circuit *\/ ...)

      Typparameter:
      R - the result type
      A - the input value type for k
      B - the produced value type of the resulting continuation
      Parameter:
      computation - a function receiving the current continuation k and producing a computation
      Gibt zurück:
      a continuation that runs computation with the current continuation
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if computation is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0
